children: Steel Dynamics provided Q3 2026 earnings guidance of $5.34 to $5.38 per diluted share, up from $3.69 in Q2 2026.
Company expects Q3 2026 EPS of $5.34–$5.38, versus $3.69 in sequential Q2 and $2.74 in prior-year Q3.
Steel operations projected to see significantly higher profitability driven by metal margin expansion and record shipments.
Metals recycling earnings expected to decline sequentially due to narrower metal spreads and modestly lower shipments.
Steel fabrication earnings forecast to improve modestly as stronger shipments offset metal spread compression; backlog ~50% higher yoy.
Aluminum earnings to improve meaningfully with increased shipments; Columbus mill cold mills operational and first CASH line to ship in Q4.
Repurchased $261 million of common stock (~just under 1% of shares) so far in Q3 2026.
